manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Changeling Hero must be exiled by Yannik, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Yannik until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
